environment.description: Same service deployed on an internal OpenShift 4.14 cluster with the following runtime characteristics: (1) The credential vending subsystem uses a Vault Transit backend with a derived-key rotation policy where HMAC signing keys are rotated via a cron-triggered Vault lease revocation every 60 seconds — the CredentialStore.validateToken() call hits Vault's /transit/verify endpoint which rejects signatures from any key version older than the current active version (i.e., tokens minted >60s ago are cryptographically invalid since the signing key version is pruned from the keyring via min_decryption_version advancement). (2) The pod runs with a custom seccomp profile (pipeline-cache-restricted.json) that blocks execve, fork, clone, and socket-connect syscalls beyond the pre-established Vault connection, meaning even if deserialization triggers a gadget chain, the resulting Runtime.exec() or ProcessBuilder call will receive EPERM from the kernel. (3) An OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate enforces that no pod in the build namespace may have NET_RAW or SYS_PTRACE capabilities, and the container's SecurityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation=false with a read-only root filesystem.
